name: MODULAR_VANISHING_ENDPOINT_TERM
description: Replaces an algebraically simplifiable resonance formula with a modular congruence that evaluates to exactly the same condition ($x=y$) but incorporates the edge endpoints in a term that vanishes under the modulo. This defeats models by preventing them from recognizing the underlying 3-coloring constraint, forcing them to use naive unoptimized backtracking which will TLE.
